name: How do I choose the right contractor for a second story addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a second story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a second story addition, look for extensive experience specifically in multi-story additions and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Verify their licensing, insurance, and ask for references from previous clients. A reputable contractor should provide a detailed proposal, transparent pricing, and clear communication throughout the design and construction phases. Also, ensure they are familiar with local building codes in your area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with extensive experience in multi-story additions, verify their license and insurance, check references, and ensure transparent communication and pricing.
